body.detail: Vendor vnd-002 is inactive. Purchase orders need an active vendor.

evidence.expected: docs: inactive_vendor_gate — no PO for inactive vendor
evidence.reason: API rejected the inactive-vendor PO with 400 and rule inactive_vendor_gate.

body.detail: Cannot receive 11 of LUM-2X4-8: ordered 10, already received 0.

evidence.expected: docs: receive_quantity_limit — received never exceeds ordered
evidence.reason: Receiving 11 against an order of 10 was rejected with receive_quantity_limit.

evidence.expected: docs: overpayment_protection — invoiced value never exceeds received value; there is no tolerance
evidence.reason: Received value was $10.00; invoice at unit_price 10.01 was accepted with 201 and total_amount 10.01. Reproduced on fresh data (po-84beb25e → inv-607a6a0f, HTTP 201). Money at risk: at least $0.01 per invoice via unit-price padding (quantity overage is blocked).

body.detail: Invoice inv-252e7552 must pass the 3-way match before approval.

evidence.expected: docs: three_way_match_gate — cannot approve until 3-way match passed
evidence.reason: Approving an unmatched invoice returned 400 with three_way_match_gate.

evidence.expected: docs: partial_receipt_flag — match sets partial_receipt true when any PO line is not fully received
evidence.reason: PO had LUM fully received and CEM at 0/4; match returned partial_receipt=false. Reproduced on fresh data (inv-dac089ca, partial_receipt=false while CEM still 0 of 4). Control flag is wrong: reviewers can miss incomplete receipt while matching/approving.

evidence.expected: docs: duplicate_invoice_detection — same invoice number ignored for case and surrounding spaces (INV-7, inv-7, ' INV-7 ' are the same)
evidence.reason: After INV-DUP was accepted, inv-dup was also accepted with 201. Surrounding-spaces variant also accepted. Reproduced on fresh data (INV-DUP-* then inv-dup-* both 201; INV-SPC-* then ' INV-SPC-* ' both 201). Money at risk: duplicate AP of the invoice total (e.g. $23.75 × 2 in the attack).

evidence.expected: docs: gl_balance — debits equal credits, balanced true
evidence.reason: Approval returned balanced=true with equal debit and credit amounts.

body.detail: SKU CEM-30KG is not on the purchase order.

evidence.expected: docs: invoice_line_validation — every line SKU on PO, each SKU once
evidence.reason: Invoice for a SKU not on the PO was rejected with invoice_line_validation.

body.detail: Goods can only be received on a submitted purchase order. po-7f94f3b3 is draft.

evidence.expected: docs: workflow_gate — receive only on submitted PO
evidence.reason: Receive on a draft PO was rejected with workflow_gate.

evidence.expected: docs: vendor_exposure_math — sum of total_amount of approved invoices
evidence.reason: open_ap_liability 38.98 matched the sum of the two approved invoice totals.

body.detail: line_items.0.quantity: quantity must be greater than 0

evidence.expected: docs: quantity greater than 0; unit_price from 0 to 100000
evidence.reason: Zero quantity on a PO line was rejected with validation_error.

summary: Happy path PASS (11/11 explorer steps as-documented). Of 12 rules tested (11 documented business rules plus validation_error), 9 held and 3 breached. Breaches: (1) overpayment_protection — a $0.01 unit-price overage on a $10.00 receipt is accepted (quantity overages are blocked), so AP can be overstated by at least a cent per invoice via price padding; (2) duplicate_invoice_detection — case and surrounding-space variants of the same invoice number are both accepted, risking duplicate payment of the full invoice total (e.g. $23.75 twice in the attack); (3) partial_receipt_flag — when only the first PO line is received, match returns partial_receipt=false instead of true, so incomplete receipt can be missed before approval (control failure; match still succeeds for the invoiced amount). Quantity-based overpayment, inactive vendors, workflow order, GL balance, exposure math, and related gates held.
